dan only.bio: Toronto native Dan Only, born Danny Vee, is a producer, musician and DJ whose hardware-driven electronic music moves through house, techno, breaks and dub. A Juno-nominated artist and one half of Cloudsteppers with Ciel, he has released music through labels including 3024, X-Kalay, Dirt Crew, New Kanada and Hâws.

ayah.bio: Palestinian-Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Merna Bishouty first released music under the name Ayah before continuing her career as Merna. After settling in Toronto, she built a soulful R&B catalogue that included collaborations with DJ Jazzy Jeff, Slakah the Beatchild and Toronto rapper Adam Bomb.

calamine.bio: Calamine, the stage name of Julie Gagnon, is a Quebec rapper, beatmaker and DJ whose francophone hip-hop pairs feminist, queer and anti-capitalist writing with self-produced beats. Originally from Sainte-Foy in Quebec City and now associated with Montreal’s scene, she was named a Radio-Canada Revelation and won the Prix Félix-Leclerc de la chanson.

david campana.bio: Montreal artist David Campana makes francophone trap and R&B that mixes melodic vocals, soul textures and contemporary rap production. His independent catalogue includes Bonjour, Hi, Trop de Love and the Saint-Henri-era single PAUSE, with his work regularly appearing in Quebec rap playlists and media.

angelica appelman.bio: Kitchener-born Angelica Appelman is a Canadian country singer-songwriter based in Stratford, Ontario. Her contemporary country sound draws on the 1990s artists she grew up with while pairing hook-driven production with personal storytelling across releases including A Reason or A Season and Half Hearted.
